description: Search the hand-curated Agent Toolbox directory by words and category. Matching is a case-insensitive substring over the name, description, and tags. It does not crawl the web or claim a server is healthy.

category.description: Exact category name. Example: "MCP". Omit it to search every category.

query.description: Words to find. Example: "mcp". An empty string returns the category, or the whole directory.

name: search_directory
title: Search the curated directory
